  71+ 0000 ~                                    ldCopyByte  vectorX, varP           ; set P to nosevX lo (may be redundant)

  76+ 0000 ~                                    ldCopy2Byte vectorX, varR           ; Set (S R) = nosev_x

  78+ 0000 ~                                    call madXAequQmulAaddRS             ; Set (A X) = Q * A + (S R)

  80+ 0000                                      ENDM

 540+ 0000 ~                                        cp      128                     ; CMP #Y*2               \ jump to LL137 to return from the subroutine with the
 541+ 0000 ~                                        jp      nc, prefix1?_LL137_6502          ; BCS LL137              \ C flag set, as the line doesn't fit on-screen
 542+ 0000 ~            ;-- If we get here, XX13 = 95 or 191, and in both cases (x2, y2) is off-screen, so we now need to swap the (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) coordinates around before doing the actual clipping, because we need to clip (x2, y2) but the clipping routine at LL118 only clips (x1, y1)

 550+ 0000 ~                                        ld      ( prefix1?_XX1576),hl

 553+ 0000 ~                                        dec     (hl)                    ; DEC SWAP               \ Set SWAP = &FF to indicate that we just clipped the line at the (x2, y2) end by swapping the coordinates (the DEC does this as we set SWAP to 0 at the start of this subroutine)

 555+ 0000 ~                                        ld      (Yreg),a                ; TAY                    \ the call to this subroutine
 556+ 0000 ~                                        call    prefix1?_LL146_6502              ; JMP LL146              \ Jump up to LL146 to move the low bytes of (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) into (X1, Y1) and (X2, Y2), and return from the subroutine with a successfully clipped line
 557+ 0000 ~                                        ret                             ; then exit so we don't pop it twice

  89+ 0000              ; Sets IYH to sign bits, bit 7 = x, bit 6 = y bit 5 = z
  90+ 0000              SetIYHToSignBits:       MACRO
  91+ 0000 ~                                    ld      a,(ix+POS_ZSGNOFFSET)   ; get Z sign
  92+ 0000 ~                                    and     $80                     ; and shift it via A into IYH bit 7
  93+ 0000 ~                                    srl     a                       ;
  94+ 0000 ~                                    ld      iyh,a                   ;
  95+ 0000 ~                                    ld      a,(ix+POS_YSGNOFFSET)   ; get Y sign
  96+ 0000 ~                                    and     $80                     ; and shift it via A into IYH bit 7
  97+ 0000 ~                                    or      iyh                     ; which moves Z into IYH bit 6
  98+ 0000 ~                                    srl     a                       ;
  99+ 0000 ~                                    ld      iyh,a                   ;
 100+ 0000 ~                                    ld      a,(ix+POS_XSGNOFFSET)   ; get X sign
 101+ 0000 ~                                    and     $80                     ; and shift it via A into IYH bit 7
 102+ 0000 ~                                    or      iyh                     ; which moves Y into IYH bit 6 and Z into IYH bit 5
 103+ 0000 ~                                    ld      iyh,a                   ;
 104+ 0000                                      ENDM

  86+ 62FA              ; hl -> 9 byte position (x, y, z each lo, hi, sign). Returns carry set if the object is within 1.0 of us on every axis.
  87+ 62FA              ; The integer part of each S15.8 axis is the sign byte bits 0-6 (upper) and the hi byte (lower); an axis is far enough
  88+ 62FA              ; away if the upper byte is non zero or the lower byte is > 1, and one far axis is enough to allow the warp.

 189+ 6D57              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ 6D57              ; DrawSunDistance / DrawPlanetDistance / DrawStationDistance: print the integer part of the distance to the sun, planet
 191+ 6D57              ; and space station on layer 2 to the right of their compass sprites.
 192+ 6D57              ; The compass sprites sit in the left border (sprite x 0-33, top y = Sun/Planet/StationCompassTLY, layer 2 is offset by
 193+ 6D57              ; 32,32 from sprite coordinates), so the text goes at the left of the 3D view, centred on each compass where possible.
 194+ 6D57              ; That area is cleared every frame, so these are called every frame from the main loop rather than from UpdateConsole,
 195+ 6D57              ; which only runs on console refresh frames.
 196+ 6D57              ; Distance ~= max + 3/8 (mid + min) of |x|, |y|, |z| (within about +13% / -3%), using the integer part of each
 197+ 6D57              ; S15.8 position (sign byte bits 0-6 and the hi byte), so it fits 16 bits (max 57341)

 199+ 6D57              SunDistanceRow          equ 2                                       ; sun compass centre is above layer 2, so top text row

1238+ 7578              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1239+ 7578              ; Radar edge markers: when the sun, planet or space station is outside the scanner range in X or Z (|x| or |z| >= 64,
1240+ 7578              ; the same limit the blips use, y is ignored) a dot is put on the scanner outline in its direction. The direction is the
1241+ 7578              ; one a blip would use (column = x, row = z / 4) and the ray is stepped out a row at a time until it reaches the outline.
1242+ 7578              ; The outline is not a true ellipse so its half widths are tabled, measured from the console image: columns 59-196,
1243+ 7578              ; rows 155-190, centre 127.5, 172.5 (left and right are symmetric about it)
1244+ 7578              RadarEdgeRowAbove       equ 172                         ; k rows up from here for objects in front (z +ve)
1245+ 7578              RadarEdgeRowBelow       equ 173                         ; k rows down from here for objects behind (z -ve)
1246+ 7578              RadarEdgeColRight       equ 128                         ; w columns right from here for x +ve
1247+ 7578              RadarEdgeColLeft        equ 127                         ; w columns left from here for x -ve
1248+ 7578              RadarEdgeRows           equ 18                          ; k = 0..17
1249+ 7578 44 44 43 43  RadarEdgeUp:            DB  68,68,67,67,66,65,64,62,60,58,56,53,50,46,42,36,29,19   ; half width at row 172 - k

  96+ 941B              ;DE.HL = D.E * H.L as  7.8 Fixed Point unsigned maths, when doing 24 bit maths scale down to 8.8 as its accurate enough
  97+ 941B              fixedS78_mulu:      ;
  98+ 941B 7A           .checkZeroMul:      ld      a,d
  99+ 941C B3                               or      e
 100+ 941D CA 45 94                         jp      z,.resultIsZero
 101+ 9420 7C                               ld      a,h
 102+ 9421 B5                               or      l
 103+ 9422 CA 45 94                         jp      z, .resultIsZero
 104+ 9425 45           .performMultiplyU:  ld      b,l                 ; b = x0
 105+ 9426 4B                               ld      c,e                 ; c =  y0
 106+ 9427 5D                               ld      e,l                 ; e = x0
 107+ 9428 6A                               ld      l,d                 ; l = y1 d is already y1
 108+ 9429 E5                               push    hl                  ; save x1 y1 to stack
 109+ 942A 69                               ld      l,c                 ; l = y0
 110+ 942B ED 30                            mul     de                  ; hl  = y1 * x0
 111+ 942D EB                               ex      de,hl               ; . also setting de to x1 y0 as we prepped them in advance
 112+ 942E ED 30                            mul     de                  ; x1*y0
 113+ 9430                                  ZeroA
 113+ 9430 AF          >                        xor a
 114+ 9431 19                               add     hl,de               ; sum cross products of y1*x0, x1 * y0 as they require no shifting
 115+ 9432 8F                               adc     a,a                 ; and capture carry bit ready for p3
 116+ 9433 59                               ld      e,c                 ; de = x0 * y0
 117+ 9434 50                               ld      d,b                 ; .
 118+ 9435 ED 30                            mul     de                  ; .
 119+ 9437 47                               ld      b,a                 ; carry from cross products setting bc to <c>h  (where <c> is carry flag)
 120+ 9438 4C                               ld      c,h                 ; .
 121+ 9439 7A                               ld      a,d                 ; h = high byte of x0 * y 0 _ lower byte of cross product of y1 * x0
 122+ 943A 85                               add     a,l                 ; .
 123+ 943B 67                               ld      h,a                 ; .)
 124+ 943C 6B                               ld      l,e                 ; so now we have lower btwo bytes of result in HL (p1 p0)
 125+ 943D D1                               pop de                      ; get x1 and y1 back from stack into de ready for multiply
 126+ 943E ED 30                            mul de                      ; hl = x1*y1 and de = p1 p0
 127+ 9440 EB                               ex de,hl                    ; .
 128+ 9441 ED 4A                            adc hl,bc                   ; hl = (x1 * y1) + <c>h (where h is upper byte of cross product from above)
 129+ 9443 EB                               ex de,hl                    ; swap over de and hl for final result
 130+ 9444 C9                               ret
 131+ 9445 11 00 00     .resultIsZero:      ld      de,0
 132+ 9448 21 00 00                         ld      hl,0
 133+ 944B C9                               ret

 546  9486                  INCLUDE "./Maths/asm_arctan.asm"
# file opened: asm_arctan.asm
   1+ 9486              ;Calculate A = arctan(P / Q)
   2+ 9486              ; This finds the angle in the right-angled triangle where the opposite side to angle A is length P and the adjacent side to angle A has
   3+ 9486              ; length Q, so:  tan(A) = P / Q
   4+ 9486              ;
   5+ 9486              ; The result in A is an integer representing the angle in radians. The routine returns values in the range 0 to 128,  (or 0 to PI radians).
   6+ 9486 3A 86 80     ARCTAN:                 ld      a,(varP)                    ; LDA P                  \ Set T1 = P EOR Q, which will have the sign of P * Q
   7+ 9489 21 B2 81                             ld      hl,varQ                     ; EOR Q
   8+ 948C AE                                   xor     (hl)                        ; .
   9+ 948D 32 83 80                             ld      (varT1),a                   ; STA T1
  10+ 9490 3A B2 81                             ld      a,(varQ)                    ; LDA Q                  \ If Q = 0, jump to AR2 to return a right angle
  11+ 9493 A7                                   and     a                           ; BEQ AR2
  12+ 9494 CA D6 94                             jp      z, .AR2                     ; .
  13+ 9497 CB 27                                sla     a                           ; ASL A                  \ Set Q = |Q| * 2 (this is a quick way of clearing the
  14+ 9499 32 B2 81                             ld      (varQ),a                    ; STA Q                  \ sign bit, and we don't need to shift right again as we only ever use this value in the division with |P| * 2, which we set next)
  15+ 949C 3A 86 80                             ld      a,(varP)                    ; LDA P                  \ Set A = |P| * 2
  16+ 949F CB 27                                sla     a                           ; ASL A
  17+ 94A1 32 86 80                             ld      (varP),a
  18+ 94A4 21 B2 81                             ld      hl,varQ
  19+ 94A7 BE                                   cp      (hl)                        ; CMP Q                  \ If A >= Q, i.e. |P| > |Q|, jump to AR1 to swap P
  20+ 94A8 D2 BA 94                             jp      nc, .AR1                    ; BCS AR1                \ and Q around, so we can still use the lookup table
  21+ 94AB CD E2 94                             call    ARS1                        ; JSR ARS1               \ Call ARS1 to set the following from the lookup table:  A = arctan(A / Q)  = arctan(|P / Q|)
  22+ 94AE                                      ClearCarryFlag                      ; SEC                    \ Set the C flag so the SBC instruction in AR3 will be correct, should we jump there
  22+ 94AE B7          >                        or a
  23+ 94AF 4F           .AR4:                   ld      c,a                         ; as we have to use a we use c as a temp, we can't push af as we would loose flags on pop
  24+ 94B0 3A 83 80                             ld      a,(varT1)                   ; LDX T1                 \ If T1 is negative, i.e. P and Q have different signs,
  25+ 94B3 47                                   ld      b,a                         ; .
  26+ 94B4 A7                                   and     a                           ; BMI AR3                \ jump down to AR3 to return arctan(-|P / Q|)
  27+ 94B5 79                                   ld      a,c                         ; .                      \ we need to get a back before jump
  28+ 94B6 FA D9 94                             jp      m, .AR3                     ; .
  29+ 94B9 C9                                   ret                                 ; RTS                    \ Otherwise P and Q have the same sign, so our result is correct and we can return from the subroutine
  30+ 94BA              ; We want to calculate arctan(t) where |t| > 1, so we can use the calculation described in the documentation for the ACT table, i.e. 64 - arctan(1 / t)
  31+ 94BA              ; In the 6502 verion it works with A already being P but we will fetch it
  32+ 94BA 3A B2 81     .AR1:                   ld      a,(varQ)                    ; LDX Q                  \ Swap the values in Q and P, using the fact that we
  33+ 94BD 47                                   ld      b,a                         ; .
  34+ 94BE 3A 86 80                             ld      a,(varP)                    ; STA Q                  \ called AR1 with A = P
  35+ 94C1 32 B2 81                             ld      (varQ),a                    ; .
  36+ 94C4 78                                   ld      a,b                         ; TXA                    \ This also sets A = P (which now contains the original argument |Q|)
  37+ 94C5 32 86 80                             ld      (varP),a                    ; STX P                  \
  38+ 94C8 CD E2 94                             call    ARS1                        ; JSR ARS1               \ Call ARS1 to set the following from the lookup table: A = arctan(A / Q) = arctan(|Q / P|) = arctan(1 / |P / Q|)
  39+ 94CB 32 CE 81                             ld      (varT),a                    ; STA T                  \ Set T = 64 - T, we use B as T (its not really that)
  40+ 94CE 47                                   ld      b,a                         ; its actually t = a, a = 64-a
  41+ 94CF 3E 40                                ld      a,64                        ; LDA #64 What is going on here is t = result
  42+ 94D1                                      ClearCarryFlag                      ; SBC T                            a = 64- result
  42+ 94D1 B7          >                        or a
  43+ 94D2 98                                   sbc     a,b                         ; .
  44+ 94D3 C3 AF 94                             jp      .AR4                        ; BCS AR4                \ Jump to AR4 to continue the calculation (this BCS is effectively a JMP as the subtraction will never underflow, as ARS1 returns values in the range 0-31)
  45+ 94D6              ; If we get here then Q = 0, so tan(A) = infinity and A is a right angle, or 0.25 of a circle. We allocate 255 to a full circle, so we should return 63 for a right angle
  46+ 94D6 3E 3F        .AR2:                   ld      a,63                        ; LDA #63                \ Set A to 63, to represent a right angle
  47+ 94D8 C9                                   ret                                 ; RTS                    \ Return from the subroutine
  48+ 94D9              ; A contains arctan(|P / Q|) but P and Q have different signs, so we need to return arctan(-|P / Q|), using the calculation described in the documentation for the ACT table, i.e. 128 - A
  49+ 94D9 32 CE 81     .AR3:                   ld      (varT),a
  50+ 94DC 47                                   ld      b,a                         ; STA T                  \ Set A = 128 - A, we use b as T
  51+ 94DD 3E 80                                ld      a,128                       ; LDA #128               \
  52+ 94DF                                      ClearCarryFlag                      ; SBC T                  \ The subtraction will work because we did a SEC before calling AR3
  52+ 94DF B7          >                        or a
  53+ 94E0 98                                   sbc     a,b
  54+ 94E1 C9                                   ret                                 ; RTS                    \ Return from the subroutine
  55+ 94E2              ; This routine fetches arctan(A / Q) from the ACT table, so A will be set to an integer in the range 0 to 31 that represents an angle from 0 to 45 degrees (or 0 to \ PI / 4 radians)
  56+ 94E2              ARS1:                   MMUSelectMathsTables
  56+ 94E2 ED 91 50 63 >                     nextreg MathsTablesMMU,    BankMathsTables
  57+ 94E6 CD 9F 07                             call    Amul256DivQ                 ; JSR LL28               \ Call LL28 to calculate: R = 256 * A / Q
  58+ 94E9 3A B3 81                             ld      a,(varR)                    ; LDA R                  \ Set X = R / 8
  59+ 94EC CB 3F                                srl     a                           ; LSR A                  \       = 32 * A / Q
  60+ 94EE CB 3F                                srl     a                           ; LSR A                  \
  61+ 94F0 CB 3F                                srl     a                           ; LSR A                  \ so X has the value t * 32 where t = A / Q, which is
  62+ 94F2 21 19 95                             ld      hl,ACT                      ; TAX                    \ what we need to look up values in the ACT table
  63+ 94F5 ED 31                                add     hl,a                        ; LDA ACT,X              \ Fetch ACT+X from the ACT table into A, so now:
  64+ 94F7 7E                                   ld      a,(hl)                      ;                        \   A = value in ACT + X = value in ACT + (32 * A / Q)= arctan(A / Q)
  65+ 94F8 C9                                   ret                                 ; RTS                    \ Return from the subroutine

 557  9708                  INCLUDE "./Maths/Utilities/badd_ll38.asm"
# file opened: badd_ll38.asm
   1+ 9708              baddll38:				;.LL38	\ -> &4812 \ BADD(S)A=R+Q(SA) \ byte add (subtract)   (Sign S)A = R + Q*(Sign from A^S)
   2+ 9708              SAEquSRPlusAQ:
   3+ 9708              ; Calculate the following between sign-magnitude numbers:
   4+ 9708              ;   (S A) = (S R) + (A Q)
   5+ 9708              ; where the sign bytes only contain the sign bits, not magnitudes.
   6+ 9708              ; note goes wrong at <-127 >128 so need 16 bit version
   7+ 9708              ; so need to fix the issue with carry flag not returning a fault correctly
   8+ 9708              LL38:
   9+ 9708              ;	ld		d,a
  10+ 9708              ;	ld		a,(varQ)
  11+ 9708              ;	ld		e,a
  12+ 9708              ;	ld		a,(varS)
  13+ 9708              ;	ld		h,a
  14+ 9708              ;	ld		a,(varR)
  15+ 9708              ;	ld		l,a
  16+ 9708              ;	call	ADDHLDESignedv3
  17+ 9708              ;	ld		a,h
  18+ 9708              ;	ld		(varS),a
  19+ 9708              ;	ld		a,l
  20+ 9708              ;	ret
  21+ 9708              ; calculation table
  22+ 9708              ;   R     Q    Op            Sign calc
  23+ 9708              ;	10    5    Add           +    sign same add R sign
  24+ 9708              ;   -10   5    ABS Sub       -    sign diff ABS R > S sub R sign
  25+ 9708              ;   10   -5    ABS sub       +    sign diff ABS R > S sub R sign
  26+ 9708              ;	-10  -5    ABS Add       -    sign same add R sign
  27+ 9708              ;   5    10    Add           +    sign same add R sign
  28+ 9708              ;   -5   10    Swap ABS SUB  +    sign diff ABS Q > R swap SUB Q sign
  29+ 9708              ;   5    -10   swap ABS Sub  -    sign diff ABS Q > R swap SUB R sign
  30+ 9708              ;   -5   -10   ABS  add      -    sign same add R sign
  31+ 9708
  32+ 9708              ;   -10   5    ABS Sub       -    sign diff ABS R > S sub R sign
  33+ 9708              ;   10   -5    ABS sub       +    sign diff ABS R > S sub R sign
  34+ 9708              ;   -5   10    Swap ABS SUB  +    sign diff ABS Q > R swap SUB Q sign
  35+ 9708              ;   5    -10   swap ABS Sub  -    sign diff ABS Q > R swap SUB R sign
  36+ 9708
  37+ 9708
  38+ 9708              ; Calculate sign for Q from A and varS
  39+ 9708 21 B4 81     	ld		hl,varS							;
  40+ 970B AE           	xor		(hl)							;  EOR &83		\ S	\ sign of operator is A xor S
  41+ 970C FA 17 97     	jp		m,.LL39Subtraction  			; if signs are different then we have subtraction
  42+ 970F 3A B2 81     	ld		a,(varQ)						; Q	\ else addition, S already correct

 528+ C473              ; 12   X1            X2    OK         2 LT X1
 529+ C473              ; 1    X1  2         X2    FAIL       1 LT X1 && 2 GT X1 && 2 LT X2
 530+ C473              ;      X1  12        X2    FAIL       1 GT X1 && 1 LT X2 && 2 GT X1 && 2 LT X2
 531+ C473              ;      X1  1         X2 2  FAIL       1 GT X1 && 1 LT X2 && 2 GT X2
 532+ C473              ;      X1            X2 12 OK         1 GT X2
 533+ C473              ; Checks to see if we have enough room to print text. srm_printed_text holds the buffer
 534+ C473              ; Carry flag is set on failure
 535+ C473              ;                 cache left   between
 536+ C473
 537+ C473              ;   h =top row, l = bottom row <not needed now>, d = left, e = right, ix = pointer to data
 538+ C473              ;   If A == N, then Z flag is set.
 539+ C473              ;   If A != N, then Z flag is reset.
 540+ C473              ;   If A < N, then C flag is set.

  27+ E719              ;; Using Bresenham Algorithm draw a diagonal line top to bottom. First we must sort of course
  28+ E719              ;;plotLine(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
  29+ E719              ;;    dx =  abs(x1-x0);
  30+ E719              ;;    sx = x0<x1 ? 1 : -1;

  62+ ED8A              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  63+ ED8A              ; l2_draw_6502_line - clip and draw a line in the Layer 2 upper two thirds (256x128, rows 0-63 bank 0, rows 64-127 bank 1)
  64+ ED8A              ; In : x1,y1,x2,y2 16 bit signed, nominally -1024..+1024 (any value within +/-2047 is safe)
  65+ ED8A              ;      colour from line_gfx_colour, Layer 2 code bank paged in (MMUSelectLayer2)
  66+ ED8A              ; Out: carry set   - line wholly outside the window, nothing drawn
  67+ ED8A              ;      carry clear - line drawn, x1,y1,x2,y2 hold the clipped end points (high bytes 0)
  68+ ED8A              ;      AF, BC, DE, HL, AF' destroyed, IX and IY preserved
  69+ ED8A              ; y1 = y2           horizontal, clamped without any maths, P1 = P2 plots a single pixel, long spans are a DMA fill
  70+ ED8A              ; x1 = x2           vertical, clamped without any maths, column fill split at the bank 0/1 boundary
  71+ ED8A              ; otherwise         Cohen-Sutherland outcodes for trivial accept/reject, edge intersections via 12x12 multiply and
  72+ ED8A              ;                   24/16 divide (rounded), then the clipped line is re-checked for pixel/horz/vert before an 8 bit Bresenham
  73+ ED8A              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  74+ ED8A              L2L_OC_LEFT_BIT         equ     0
  75+ ED8A              L2L_OC_RIGHT_BIT        equ     1
  76+ ED8A              L2L_OC_TOP_BIT          equ     2
  77+ ED8A              L2L_OC_BOTTOM_BIT       equ     3
  78+ ED8A              L2L_OC_LEFT             equ     1 << L2L_OC_LEFT_BIT            ; x < 0
  79+ ED8A              L2L_OC_RIGHT            equ     1 << L2L_OC_RIGHT_BIT           ; x > 255
  80+ ED8A              L2L_OC_TOP              equ     1 << L2L_OC_TOP_BIT             ; y < 0
  81+ ED8A              L2L_OC_BOTTOM           equ     1 << L2L_OC_BOTTOM_BIT          ; y > 127
  82+ ED8A              L2L_CLIP_MAX_X          equ     255
  83+ ED8A              L2L_CLIP_MAX_Y          equ     127
  84+ ED8A              L2L_CLIP_MAX_PASSES     equ     8                               ; Cohen-Sutherland needs at most 4, guards against a rounding loop
  85+ ED8A              L2L_DMA_MIN             equ     20                              ; spans this long or longer use DMA, the program upload costs ~20 pixels of CPU loop
  86+ ED8A              L2L_OPCODE_INC_L        equ     $2C
  87+ ED8A              L2L_OPCODE_DEC_L        equ     $2D
  88+ ED8A              L2L_DMA_WR1_FIXED_TIMED equ     $64                             ; WR1 port A memory, fixed address, timing byte follows
  89+ ED8A              L2L_DMA_WR2_INC_TIMED   equ     $50                             ; WR2 port B memory, incrementing, timing byte follows
  90+ ED8A              L2L_DMA_CYCLE_2T        equ     $02                             ; timing byte, 2 T state cycle length
  91+ ED8A
  92+ ED8A 00           L2LClipPasses           DB      0
  93+ ED8B 00           L2LDx                   DB      0
  94+ ED8C 00           L2LDy                   DB      0
  95+ ED8D 00 00        L2LOrigX1               DW      0                               ; original line, all clip intersections are taken from this
  96+ ED8F 00 00        L2LOrigY1               DW      0
  97+ ED91 00 00        L2LOrigDx               DW      0

   1+ F17B              ; ******************************************************************************
   2+ F17B              ;
   3+ F17B              ;	Draw a pixel line from (x0,y0) defined in (COORDS) - the current plot
   4+ F17B              ;	coordinate, to the relative distance points (x0+x,y0+y).
   5+ F17B              ;
   6+ F17B              ;	Design & programming by Gunther Strube,	Copyright (C) InterLogic 1995
   7+ F17B              ;
   8+ F17B              ;	The (COORDS+0)	pointer contains the current y coordinate, (COORDS+1) the
   9+ F17B              ;	current x coordinate. The main program should reset the (COORDS) variables
  10+ F17B              ;	before using line drawing.
  11+ F17B              ;
  12+ F17B              ;	The routine checks the range of specified coordinates which is the
  13+ F17B              ;	boundaries of the graphics area (256x64	pixels).
  14+ F17B              ;	If a boundary error occurs the routine exits automatically.	This may be
  15+ F17B              ;	useful if you are trying to draw a line longer than allowed. Only the
  16+ F17B              ;	visible part will be drawn.
  17+ F17B              ;
  18+ F17B              ;	The hardware graphics memory is organized as (0,0) in the top left corner.
  19+ F17B              ;
  20+ F17B              ;	The plot routine is	defined by an address pointer	in IX.
  21+ F17B              ;
  22+ F17B              ;	IN:	HL =	move	relative x horisontal points (maximum +/- 255).
  23+ F17B              ;		DE =	move	relative y vertical	points (maximum +/-	255).
  24+ F17B              ;		IX =	pointer to plot routine that uses HL = (x,y)	of plot coordinate.
  25+ F17B              ;
  26+ F17B              ;	OUT:	None.
  27+ F17B              ;
  28+ F17B              ;	Registers	used	by routine:
  29+ F17B              ;		   N	:	B, loop counter
  30+ F17B              ;		   i	:	line	balance variable
  31+ F17B              ;		   x	:	H/L,	horisontal, vertical distance	variables
  32+ F17B              ;		   y	:	H/L,	horisontal, vertical distance	variables
  33+ F17B              ;	  (x0,y0)	:	(h,l)
  34+ F17B              ;	  direc_x	:	d, horisontal step increment
  35+ F17B              ;	  direc_y	:	e, vertical step increment
  36+ F17B              ;		 ddx	:	b, horisontal step increment
  37+ F17B              ;		 ddy	:	c, vertical step increment
  38+ F17B              ;
  39+ F17B              ;		DE, A work registers.
  40+ F17B              ;
  41+ F17B              ; The algorithm in pseudo-code:
  42+ F17B              ;
  43+ F17B              ;	direc_x =	SGN x: direc_y	= SGN y
  44+ F17B              ;	x = ABS x: y =	ABS y
  45+ F17B              ;
  46+ F17B              ;	if x	>= y
  47+ F17B              ;		if x+y=0 then return
  48+ F17B              ;		H = x
  49+ F17B              ;		L = y
  50+ F17B              ;		ddx = direc_x
  51+ F17B              ;		ddy = 0
  52+ F17B              ;	else
  53+ F17B              ;		H = y
  54+ F17B              ;		L = x
  55+ F17B              ;		ddx = 0
  56+ F17B              ;		ddy = direc_y
  57+ F17B              ;	endif
  58+ F17B              ;
  59+ F17B              ;	B = H
  60+ F17B              ;	i = INT(B/2)
  61+ F17B              ;	FOR N=B TO 1 STEP -1
  62+ F17B              ;		i = i + L
  63+ F17B              ;		if i	< H
  64+ F17B              ;			ix =	ddx
  65+ F17B              ;			iy =	ddy
  66+ F17B              ;		else
  67+ F17B              ;			i = i - H
  68+ F17B              ;			ix =	direc_x
  69+ F17B              ;			iy =	direc_y
  70+ F17B              ;		endif
  71+ F17B              ;		x0 =	x0 +	ix
  72+ F17B              ;		y0 =	y0 +	iy
  73+ F17B              ;		plot	(x0,y0)
  74+ F17B              ;	NEXT	N
  75+ F17B              ;
  76+ F17B              ;
  77+ F17B              ;	Registers	changed after return:
  78+ F17B              ;		..BCDEHL/IXIY/af......	same
  79+ F17B              ;		AF....../..../..bcdehl	different
  80+ F17B              ;
  81+ F17B 00 00        line_gfx_coords         dw  0
  82+ F17D
  83+ F17D              LineHLtoDE:
  84+ F17D 7C           TestMaxY:               ld	a,h ; were h = y or l = y?
  85+ F17E FE C0                                cp	192
  86+ F180 30 26                                jr	nc, exit_line		; y0	coordinate out	of range
  87+ F182 7A                                   ld	a,d
  88+ F183 FE C0                                cp	192
  89+ F185 30 21                                jr	nc, exit_line		; y1	coordinate out	of range
  90+ F187 22 7B F1                             ld	(line_gfx_coords),hl		; the starting	point is now default
  91+ F18A E5                                   push	hl
  92+ F18B D5                                   push	de
  93+ F18C 6C                                   ld	l,h				; L = x0
  94+ F18D 62                                   ld	h,d				; H = x1
  95+ F18E 7C           distanceX:		        ld	a,h
  96+ F18F 95                                   sub	l
  97+ F190 6F                                   ld	l,a

 115+ F1A9              ; ***************************************************************************
 116+ F1A9              ;
 117+ F1A9              ;	IN:	HL =	move	relative x horisontal points (maximum +/- 255).
 118+ F1A9              ;		DE =	move	relative y vertical	points (maximum +/-	255).
 119+ F1A9              ;
 120+ F1A9              ; OUT: h - l distance in	HL
 121+ F1A9              ;
 122+ F1A9
 123+ F1A9 D5           DrawLineRelative:       push	de
 124+ F1AA E5                                   push	hl
 125+ F1AB D9                                   exx
 126+ F1AC E1                                   pop	hl					; get relative	horisontal movement
 127+ F1AD CD 24 F2                             call	sgn
 128+ F1B0 57                                   ld	d,a					; direc_x	= SGN(x) installed d = +/-1 for horizontal update
 129+ F1B1 CD 31 F2                             call	absValue
 130+ F1B4 45                                   ld	b,l					; x = ABS(x)
 131+ F1B5 E1           DrawLineGetVertRelative:pop	hl					; get relative	vertical movement
 132+ F1B6 CD 24 F2                             call	sgn
 133+ F1B9 5F                                   ld	e,a					; direc_y	= SGN(y) installed  = +/-1 for vertical update
 134+ F1BA CD 31 F2                             call	absValue
 135+ F1BD 4D                                   ld	c,l					; y = ABS(y) so now bc = dxdy
 136+ F1BE              ; so by here BC = dx dy HL in increment/decrement x y
 137+ F1BE C5                                   push	bc
 138+ F1BF D9                                   exx
 139+ F1C0 E1                                   pop	hl					; H = absolute	x dist., L = absolute y distance
 140+ F1C1 7C                                   ld	a,h

 143+ F1C5 B4           areXandYZero:           or	h					;	if x+y = 0

 146+ F1C9 42                                   ld	b,d					;		ddx = direc_x
 147+ F1CA 0E 00                                ld	c,0					;		ddy = 0

 208+ F224              ; ******************************************************************************
 209+ F224              ;
 210+ F224              ;	SGN (Signum value) of 16	bit signed integer.
 211+ F224              ;
 212+ F224              ;	IN:		HL =	integer
 213+ F224              ;	OUT:		A = result: 0,1,-1 (if zero, positive, negative)
 214+ F224              ;
 215+ F224              ;	Registers	changed after return:
 216+ F224              ;	..BCDEHL/IXIY	same
 217+ F224              ;	AF....../....	different
 218+ F224              ;
 219+ F224 7C           sgn:				    ld	a,h
 220+ F225 B5                                   or	l
 221+ F226 C8                                   ret	z				; integer	is zero, return 0...

 223+ F229 20 03                                jr	nz, negative_int
 224+ F22B 3E 01                                ld	a,1
 225+ F22D C9                                   ret
 226+ F22E 3E FF        negative_int:		    ld	a,-1
 227+ F230 C9                                   ret
 228+ F231
 229+ F231
 230+ F231              ; ******************************************************************************
 231+ F231              ;
 232+ F231              ;	ABS (Absolute value) of 16 bit signed integer.
 233+ F231              ;
 234+ F231              ;	IN:		HL =	integer
 235+ F231              ;	OUT:		HL =	converted	integer
 236+ F231              ;
 237+ F231              ;	Registers	changed after return:
 238+ F231              ;	A.BCDE../IXIY	same
 239+ F231              ;	.F....HL/....	different
 240+ F231              ;
 241+ F231 CB 7C        absValue:			    bit	7,h
 242+ F233 C8                                   ret	z				; integer	is positive...

 245+ F236 21 00 00                             ld	hl,0

 207+ E0BC              ;    Spr,   pattern     spr+1, pattern+1

 209+ E0BC              ; " sprite_big BC = row, hl= col D = sprite nbr , E= , pattern"

 144++C0BE              ; Flags work as follows:
 145++C0BE              ; UBnKSpawnObject - signals on death to spawn cargo items
 146++C0BE              ; 0 -                   Spawn Cargo 1
 147++C0BE              ; 1 -                   Spawn Cargo 2
 148++C0BE              ; 2 -                   Spawn Cargo 3
 149++C0BE              ; 3 -                   Spawn Cargo 4
 150++C0BE              ; 4 -                   Spawn Alloy 1
 151++C0BE              ; 5 -                   Spawn Alloy 2
 152++C0BE              ; 6 -                   Spawn Alloy 3
 153++C0BE              ; 7 -                   Spawn Alloy 4
 154++C0BE
 155++C0BE              ; UBnkaiatkecm
 156++C0BE              ; Bit	                Description
 157++C0BE              ; 7 -                   AI Enabled Flag
 158++C0BE              ; 6 -                   Ship Visible = ShipOnScreen/NotCloaked (cleared or set by check visible or cloaking override)
 159++C0BE              ; 5 -                   Ship is exploding if set, note if its a missile and one already equeued this will have to linger
 160++C0BE              ;                       linger can be done by not erasing ship unit missile equeue handled
 161++C0BE              ; 4 -                   Ship marked as exploded, cleared once aknowledged then bit 5 takes over and UBnKCloudCounter
 162++C0BE              ; 3 -                   Display state - Plot as a Dot
 163++C0BE              ; 2 -                   Nbr of Missiles bit 2
 164++C0BE              ; 1 -                   Nbr of Missiles bit 1
 165++C0BE              ; 0 -                   ECM present flag
 166++C0BE              ; ShipNewBitsAddr (in blueprint)
 167++C0BE              ;Bit	                Description
 168++C0BE              ;#0	Trader flag         * 0 = not a trader  * 1 = trader
 169++C0BE              ;                       80% of traders are peaceful and mind their own business plying their trade between the planet and space station, but 20% of them moonlight as bounty hunters (see bit #1)
 170++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are traders: Escape pod, Shuttle, Transporter, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Worm
 171++C0BE              ;#1 Bounty hunter flag  * 0 = not a bounty hunter* 1 = bounty hunter
 172++C0BE              ;                       If we are a fugitive or a serious offender and we bump into a bounty hunter, they will become hostile and attack us (see bit #2)
 173++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are bounty hunters: Viper, Fer-de-lance
 174++C0BE              ;#2	Hostile flag        * 0 = not hostile  * 1 = hostile
 175++C0BE              ;                       Hostile ships will attack us on sight; there are quite a few of them
 176++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are hostile: Sidewinder, Mamba, Krait, Adder, Gecko, Cobra Mk I, Worm, Cobra Mk III, Asp Mk II, Python (pirate), Moray, Thargoid, Thargon, Constrictor
 177++C0BE              ;#3	Pirate flag         * 0 = not a pirate * 1 = pirate
 178++C0BE              ;                       Hostile pirates will attack us on sight, but once we get inside the space station safe zone, they will stop
 179++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are pirates: Sidewinder, Mamba, Krait, Adder, Gecko, Cobra Mk I, Cobra Mk III, Asp Mk II, Python (pirate), Moray, Thargoid
 180++C0BE              ;#4	Docking flag        * 0 = not docking * 1 = docking
 181++C0BE              ;                       Traders with their docking flag set fly towards the space station to try to dock, otherwise they aim for the planet
 182++C0BE              ;                       This flag is randomly set for traders when they are spawned
 183++C0BE              ;                       Ships that can be docking: Escape pod, Shuttle, Transporter, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Worm
 184++C0BE              ;#5	Innocent bystander  * 0 = normal * 1 = innocent bystander
 185++C0BE              ;                       If we attack an innocent ship within the space station safe zone, then the station will get angry with us and start spawning cops
 186++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are innocent bystanders: Shuttle, Transporter, Cobra Mk III, Python, Boa, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Cougar
 187++C0BE              ;#6	Cop flag            * 0 = not a cop * 1 = cop
 188++C0BE              ;                       If we destroy a cop, then we instantly become a fugitive (the Transporter isn't actually a cop, but it's clearly under police protection)
 189++C0BE              ;                       Ships that are cops: Viper, Transporter
 190++C0BE              ;#7	Scooped, docked, escape pod flag
 191++C0BE              ;                       For spawned ships, this flag indicates that the ship been scooped or has docked (bit 7 is always clear on spawning)
 192++C0BE              ;                       For blueprints, this flag indicates whether the ship type has an escape pod fitted, so it can launch it when in dire straits
 193++C0BE              ;                       Ships that have escape pods: Cobra Mk III, Python, Boa, Anaconda, Rock hermit, Viper, Mamba, Krait, Adder, Cobra Mk I, Cobra Mk III (pirate), Asp Mk II, Python (pirate), Fer-de-lance

1499+ D703              ; Pitch and roll are 2 phases
1500+ D703              ; 1 - we apply our pitch and roll to the ship position
1501+ D703              ;       x -> x + alpha * (y - alpha * x)
1502+ D703              ;       y -> y - alpha * x - beta * z
1503+ D703              ;       z -> z + beta * (y - alpha * x - beta * z)
1504+ D703              ; which can be simplified as:
1505+ D703              ;       1. K2 = y - alpha * x
1506+ D703              ;       2. z = z + beta * K2
1507+ D703              ;       3. y = K2 - beta * z
1508+ D703              ;       4. x = x + alpha * y
1509+ D703              ; 2 - we apply our patch and roll to the ship orientation
1510+ D703              ;      Roll calculations:
1511+ D703              ;
1512+ D703              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - alpha * nosev_x_hi
1513+ D703              ;        nosev_x = nosev_x + alpha * nosev_y_hi
1514+ D703              ;      Pitch calculations:
1515+ D703              ;
1516+ D703              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - beta * nosev_z_hi
1517+ D703              ;        nosev_z = nosev_z + beta * nosev_y_hi
1518+ D703
1519+ D703

1528+ D95F              ; A dot is the ship's origin, so its screen position is the projected ship position and needs no rotation.
1529+ D95F              ; Positions are 24 bit lead sign (sgn byte bit 7 = sign, bits 0-6 = top of the magnitude). Dots are drawn out to
1530+ D95F              ; ShipMaxDistance, past the 15 bit range TransposeXX12ByShipToXX15 handles (z >= 32768 read as negative and
1531+ D95F              ; clamped to 4), so the full magnitudes are scaled down to 8 bit here and handed straight to ProjectNodeToEye
1532+ D95F 00 00 00...  DotPosition             DS      9                       ; x, y, z magnitudes as lo, hi, top with the signs removed

  14+ C000              CheckRowHLOnScreen:     MACRO   failtarget
  15+ C000 ~                                    ld      a,h                             ; is h byte set, i.e > 256 or < 0
  16+ C000 ~                                    and     a                               ; .
  17+ C000 ~                                    jr      nz,failtarget                   ; h <> 0 so fails (covers <0 and > 255
  18+ C000 ~                                    ld      a,l                             ; l bit 7 0?
  19+ C000 ~                                    and     Bit7Only                        ; covers l > 127 (screen draw area is 0 to 192 / 3 * 2 (128)
  20+ C000 ~                                    jr      nz,failtarget                   ;
  21+ C000                                      ENDM

  36+ C000 ~                                    inc     hl
  37+ C000 ~                                    ld      d,(hl)                  ; d = right col
  38+ C000 ~                                    inc     hl                      ; now ready for next linel
  39+ C000 ~                                    push    hl,,bc

  41+ C000 ~                                    IfResultZeroGoto .NoLineDraw

 559+ C4EC              ; Pitch and roll are 2 phases
 560+ C4EC              ; 1 - we apply our pitch and roll to the ship position
 561+ C4EC              ;       x -> x + alpha * (y - alpha * x)
 562+ C4EC              ;       y -> y - alpha * x - beta * z
 563+ C4EC              ;       z -> z + beta * (y - alpha * x - beta * z)
 564+ C4EC              ; which can be simplified as:
 565+ C4EC              ;       1. K2 = y - alpha * x
 566+ C4EC              ;       2. z = z + beta * K2
 567+ C4EC              ;       3. y = K2 - beta * z
 568+ C4EC              ;       4. x = x + alpha * y
 569+ C4EC              ; 2 - we apply our patch and roll to the ship orientation
 570+ C4EC              ;      Roll calculations:
 571+ C4EC              ;
 572+ C4EC              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - alpha * nosev_x_hi
 573+ C4EC              ;        nosev_x = nosev_x + alpha * nosev_y_hi
 574+ C4EC              ;      Pitch calculations:
 575+ C4EC              ;
 576+ C4EC              ;        nosev_y = nosev_y - beta * nosev_z_hi
 577+ C4EC              ;        nosev_z = nosev_z + beta * nosev_y_hi
 578+ C4EC

  25++C4EC              ;  y -= alpha * x    y -= beta * z
  26++C4EC              ;  x += alpha * y    z += beta * y

  28++C4EC              ;   1. K2 = y - alpha * x
  29++C4EC              ;   2. z = z + beta * K2

 969+ C75B              ; y min = 0   y center is negative radius <= ABS (Y center)             => Don't draw
 970+ C75B              ; y min = 0   y center is negative radius > ABS (Y center)+1            => Draw bottom half only
 971+ C75B              ; y max = 127 y center is > 127    radius <= y center - 127             => Don't draw
 972+ C75B              ; y max = 127 y center is > 127    radius > y center - 127              => Draw top half only
 973+ C75B              ; y min >= 0  y center > y min     we don't need to worry about radius  => Draw both halves
 974+ C75B              ; x center + radius < 0                                                 => Don't draw
 975+ C75B              ; x center - radius > 255                                               => Don't draw
 976+ C75B              ; we won't consider x more here as the driver is the y coordinate but we will check if x is vaiable
 977+ C75B              ; x point = max (x point, 0)   on left
 978+ C75B              ; x point = min (x point, 255) on right
 979+ C75B
 980+ C75B              SetIYPlusOffset:        MACRO   reg
 981+ C75B ~                                    push    hl,,iy                          ; save hl, then hl = iy

 647+ C863              ; we only hit this if z is positive so we can ignore signs
 648+ C863              ; radius = 16384 / (z / 256): BBC Elite uses 24576 (on the same X / (Z / 256) scale as the projected centre), scaled to
 649+ C863              ; 2/3 as our view is 128 rows high against the BBC 192, so the size still grows in step with
 650+ C863              ; the position. Worked as 32768 / (z / 128) for an extra bit of precision: PlanetUpdateAndRender only draws when
 651+ C863              ; z sign < 48 and z >= 256, so z / 128 is 2..24575 and fits the 16 bit divisor. Any radius 1..248 (odd or even)
 652+ C863              ; so the planet grows a pixel at a time rather than jumping

 656+ C869 3A 16 C0                             ld      a,(P_BnKzlo)                 ; .

 658+ C86D 3A 17 C0                             ld      a,(P_BnKzhi)                 ; .

 339+ E104 DD 21 38 E0  scan_keyboard:          ld		ix,RawKeys                      ; hl = table of raw IO port readings
 340+ E108 21 42 E0                             ld		hl,KeyAddrTab                   ; de = table of IO ports to read
 341+ E10B 0E 08                                ld		c,8                             ; 8 ports to ready
 342+ E10D 11 00 E0                             ld      de,Keys                         ; ix = table of key states from raw read
 343+ E110 7E           .PortReadLoop:          ld		a,(hl)							; Set up port to read as (hl)$FE
 344+ E111 DB FE                                in		a,($FE)							; read port to a
 345+ E113 DD 77 00                             ld      (ix+0),a                        ; save raw scan
 346+ E116 DD 23                                inc     ix
 347+ E118 23                                   inc		hl                              ; and ready for next read
 348+ E119 06 05        .ProcessInputBits:      ld		b,5								; loop all bits (there are only 5 keys to a group)
 349+ E11B 1F           .ProcessBitsLoop:       rra                                     ; shit bit 0 into carry
 350+ E11C 30 08                                jr      nc,.SetKeyPressed               ; low bit means it was pressed
 351+ E11E FD 6F                                ld      iyl,a
 352+ E120                                      ZeroA
 352+ E120 AF          >                        xor a
 353+ E121 C3 2E E1                             jp      .SetKey
 354+ E124 20 0B                                jr		nz,.SkipKeySet
 355+ E126 FD 6F        .SetKeyPressed:	        ld      iyl,a                           ; save current input byte
 356+ E128 1A                                   ld      a,(de)                          ; get current keystate
 357+ E129 FE 02                                cp      2
 358+ E12B 28 02                                jr      z,.AlreadyHeld
 359+ E12D 3C                                   inc     a                               ; and increment by 1 as its moved from previous state
 360+ E12E 12           .SetKey:                ld		(de),a				  	        ; save key Pressed state
 361+ E12F FD 7D        .AlreadyHeld:           ld      a,iyl                           ; and retrieve the current input byte
 362+ E131 13           .SkipKeySet:	        inc		de								; move to next key
 363+ E132 10 E7                                djnz	.ProcessBitsLoop				; Process all key group bits
 364+ E134 0D                                   dec     c                               ; thats one row of bits all processed
 365+ E135 20 D9                                jr      nz,.PortReadLoop				; Read next input port
 366+ E137              .ReadExtend0:           ; bits are set to 1 for press on the next register
 367+ E137                                      GetNextReg EXTENDED_KEYS_0_REGISTER
 367+ E137 01 3B 24    >            ld bc,$243B
 367+ E13A 3E B0       >            ld a,EXTENDED_KEYS_0_REGISTER
 367+ E13C ED 79       >            out (c),a
 367+ E13E 04          >            inc b
 367+ E13F ED 78       >            in a,(c)
 368+ E141 32 40 E0                             ld      (RawKeys+8),a                   ; save to extended slot
 369+ E144 06 08                                ld      b,8
 370+ E146 21 28 E0                             ld      hl,Keys + VK_SEMI
 371+ E149 5F                                   ld      e,a                             ; e now holds the raw keys for shifting
 372+ E14A CB 13        .ProcessExtend0:        rl      e                               ; shift bits left into carry for extended keys
 373+ E14C 38 04                                jr      c,.SetExtend0KeyPressed         ; if carry they key was pressedw
 374+ E14E              .Extend0NotPressed:     ZeroA
 374+ E14E AF          >                        xor a
 375+ E14F C3 58 E1                             jp      .SetExtend0Key
 376+ E152 7E           .SetExtend0KeyPressed:  ld      a,(hl)                          ; consider if key was already held down
 377+ E153 FE 02                                cp      2
 378+ E155 28 02                                jr      z,.Extend0AlreadyHeld
 379+ E157 3C                                   inc     a
 380+ E158 77           .SetExtend0Key:         ld      (hl),a
 381+ E159 23           .Extend0AlreadyHeld:    inc     hl
 382+ E15A 10 EE                                djnz    .ProcessExtend0
 383+ E15C              .ReadExtend1:           GetNextReg EXTENDED_KEYS_1_REGISTER
 383+ E15C 01 3B 24    >            ld bc,$243B
 383+ E15F 3E B1       >            ld a,EXTENDED_KEYS_1_REGISTER
 383+ E161 ED 79       >            out (c),a
 383+ E163 04          >            inc b
 383+ E164 ED 78       >            in a,(c)
 384+ E166 32 41 E0                             ld      (RawKeys+9),a                      ; save to extended slot
 385+ E169 06 08                                ld      b,8
 386+ E16B 21 30 E0                             ld      hl,Keys + VK_DELETE
 387+ E16E 5F                                   ld      e,a
 388+ E16F CB 13        .ProcessExtend1:        rl      e                                 ; shift bits left into carry for extended keys
 389+ E171 38 04                                jr      c,.SetExtend1KeyPressed
 390+ E173              .Extend1NotPressed:     ZeroA
 390+ E173 AF          >                        xor a
 391+ E174 C3 7D E1                             jp      .SetExtend1Key
 392+ E177 7E           .SetExtend1KeyPressed:  ld      a,(hl)
 393+ E178 FE 02                                cp      2
 394+ E17A 28 02                                jr      z,.Extend1AlreadyHeld
 395+ E17C 3C                                   inc     a
 396+ E17D 77           .SetExtend1Key:         ld      (hl),a
 397+ E17E 23           .Extend1AlreadyHeld:    inc     hl
 398+ E17F 10 EE                                djnz    .ProcessExtend1
 399+ E181 C9                                   ret

   2+ 0000              ; Same signs add the magnitudes (the sign in bit 7 of B carries through), opposite signs subtract the smaller
   3+ 0000              ; magnitude from the larger and take that operand's sign. Never returns -0, overflow is not detected.
   4+ 0000              ; Destroys C and DE.

   1+ 0548              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2+ 0548              ; Floor_DivQ: BC = BC / DE (unsigned), HL = BC % DE
   3+ 0548              ; DE is preserved. BC = 0 gives BC = 0, HL = 0. DE = 0 gives BC = 1, HL = 0.
   4+ 0548              ; (The name comes from a signed floor divide; BC_Div_DE is unsigned so the result is always the plain quotient.
   5+ 0548              ;  The old signed adjustment wrongly decremented BC whenever the remainder was 32768 or more.)
   6+ 0548 78           Floor_DivQ:             ld      a,b
   7+ 0549 B1                                   or      c
   8+ 054A 28 0A                                jr      z, .divide0By   ; if bc is zero just return as result will be zero
   9+ 054C 7A                                   ld      a,d
  10+ 054D B3                                   or      e
  11+ 054E 28 0A                                jr      z, .divideBy0
  12+ 0550 D5                                   push    de
  13+ 0551 CD 61 05                             call    BC_Div_DE       ; bc = bc / de , hl = bc % de
  14+ 0554 D1                                   pop     de
  15+ 0555 C9                                   ret
  16+ 0556 21 00 00     .divide0By:             ld      hl,0            ; hl = 0, bc is already 0

  18+ 055A 21 00 00     .divideBy0:             ld      hl,0

  21+ 0561              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  22+ 0561              ; BCDIVDE_Iteration: one bit of BC_Div_DE, shifts the next dividend bit from A into the remainder HL and subtracts
  23+ 0561              ; the divisor (DE holds -divisor), the inverted quotient bit is left in carry for the next rla
  24+ 0561              BCDIVDE_Iteration:      MACRO

  26+ 0561 ~                                    adc	    hl,hl
  27+ 0561 ~                                    add	    hl,de
  28+ 0561 ~                                    jr	    c,1F
  29+ 0561 ~                                    sbc	    hl,de
  30+ 0561 ~            1:
  31+ 0561                                      ENDM

 316+ 079F              ; Amul256DivQ: varR = A = (A * 256) / varQ, unsigned (6502 LL28 port). If A >= Q, R = 255 and carry is set.
 317+ 079F              ; Q must not be 0. Destroys B, C, HL
 318+ 079F 21 B2 81     Amul256DivQ:            ld      hl,varQ                 ; CMP Q                  \ If A >= Q, then the answer will not fit in one byte,

 320+ 07A3 B9                                   cp      c
 321+ 07A4                                      FlipCarryFlag
 321+ 07A4 3F          >                        ccf
 322+ 07A5 DA CD 07                             jp      c, .LL2_6502            ; BCS LL2                \ so jump to LL2 to return 255
 323+ 07A8 06 FE                                ld      b,$FE                   ; LDX #%11111110         \ Set R to have bits 1-7 set, so we can rotate through 7 loop iterations, getting a 1 each time, and then we use b as Rvar
 324+ 07AA CB 27        .LL31_6502:             sla     a                       ; ASL A                  \ Shift A to the left
 325+ 07AC DA C1 07                             jp      c,.LL29_6502            ; BCS LL29               \ If bit 7 of A was set, then jump straight to the subtraction
 326+ 07AF                                      FlipCarryFlag                   ;                          If A < N, then C flag is set.
 326+ 07AF 3F          >                        ccf

 327+ 07B0 B9          >                        cp      c
 327+ 07B1 DA B6 07    >                        jp		c, .LL31_SKIPSUB_6502
 328+ 07B4                                                                      ; BCC P%+4
 329+ 07B4 91                                   sub     c                       ; SBC Q                  \ A >= Q, so set A = A - Q
 330+ 07B5                                      ClearCarryFlag
 330+ 07B5 B7          >                        or a
 331+ 07B6              .LL31_SKIPSUB_6502:     FlipCarryFlag
 331+ 07B6 3F          >                        ccf
 332+ 07B7 CB 10                                rl      b                       ; ROL R                  \ Rotate the counter in R to the left, and catch the result bit into bit 0 (which will be a 0 if we didn't do the subtraction, or 1 if we did)
 333+ 07B9 DA AA 07                             jp      c, .LL31_6502           ; BCS LL31               \ If we still have set bits in R, loop back to LL31 to do the next iteration of 7

 338+ 07C2 37          >                        scf
 339+ 07C3 CB 10                                rl      b                       ; ROL R                  \ Rotate the counter in R to the left, and catch the result bit into bit 0 (which will be a 0 if we didn't do the subtraction, or 1 if we did)
 340+ 07C5 DA AA 07                             jp      c, .LL31_6502           ; BCS LL31               \ If we still have set bits in R, loop back to LL31 to do the next iteration of 7
 341+ 07C8 78                                   ld      a,b                     ; RTS                    \ Return from the subroutine with R containing the
 342+ 07C9 32 B3 81                             ld      (varR),a                ; .
 343+ 07CC C9                                   ret                             ; .                      \ remainder of the division

 114+ 08AE              ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ 08AE              ; Ship version of ApplyMyRollAndPitchIX with an extra fraction byte per axis.
 116+ 08AE              ; With roll / pitch rates of only 1..2 / 256 per frame, alpha * x truncated to whole raw units is 0 for any |x| below
 117+ 08AE              ; 128..256 raw, so nearby ships close to the centre of view never moved when the player rolled. Here each axis is
 118+ 08AE              ; worked as a 32 bit 2's complement value (raw * 256 + fraction) and the fraction is kept between frames.
 119+ 08AE              ; Products are truncated towards zero so the Minsky rotation has no drift in either direction.
 120+ 08AE              ; ix = 24 bit lead sign position (x, y, z each lo, hi, sign), iy = 3 fraction bytes (x, y, z). ix and iy preserved
 121+ 08AE              ; Its work variables (RPX32 .. RPSign) are in general_variables.asm, not here: this bank is in slot 0 and writes to
 122+ 08AE              ; $0000-$3FFF can be going to layer 2, so variables in this bank read back as garbage
 123+ 08AE
 124+ 08AE              ; 32 bit 2's complement value at dest = position axis at ix+ixoff (lo, hi, sign) * 256 + fraction at iy+iyoff
 125+ 08AE              RPLoadAxis:                 MACRO   dest, ixoff, iyoff
 126+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(iy+iyoff)
 127+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest),a
 128+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff)
 129+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest+1),a
 130+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff+1)
 131+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest+2),a
 132+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(ix+ixoff+2)
 133+ 08AE ~                                        ld      b,a
 134+ 08AE ~                                        and     $7F
 135+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (dest+3),a
 136+ 08AE ~                                        bit     7,b
 137+ 08AE ~                                        jr      z,.Positive
 138+ 08AE ~                                        ld      hl,dest
 139+ 08AE ~                                        call    RPNeg32
 140+ 08AE ~            .Positive:
 141+ 08AE                                          ENDM
 142+ 08AE
 143+ 08AE              ; position axis at ix+ixoff and fraction at iy+iyoff = 32 bit 2's complement value at src (src is left as |src|)
 144+ 08AE              RPSaveAxis:                 MACRO   src, ixoff, iyoff
 145+ 08AE ~                                        ld      b,0
 146+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(src+3)
 147+ 08AE ~                                        and     a
 148+ 08AE ~                                        jp      p,.Positive
 149+ 08AE ~                                        ld      hl,src
 150+ 08AE ~                                        call    RPNeg32
 151+ 08AE ~                                        ld      b,$80
 152+ 08AE ~            .Positive:                  ld      a,(src)
 153+ 08AE ~                                        ld      (iy+iyoff),a

 156+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(src+2)

 158+ 08AE ~                                        ld      a,(src+3)

 309+ 0AA0              ; The orientation vectors are the ship's axes in the player's frame (a vertex is x*side + y*roof + z*nose, see

   2+ 0B51              ; takes a 3x24 bit vector and normalilses them, this is done by taking the ABS values scaling down into a maxioum of a 15 bit number
   3+ 0B51
   4+ 0B51              ScaleHLD:               MACRO
   5+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      a,h
   6+ 0B51 ~                                    or      l
   7+ 0B51 ~                                    or      d
   8+ 0B51 ~                                    jp      nz,.StartShift      ; if its zero then we need to set to at least 1 to avoid infinite loop and hence divide by 0 later
   9+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      a,1
  10+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      h,a
  11+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      l,a
  12+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      d,a
  13+ 0B51 ~                                    jp      .DoneShift
  14+ 0B51 ~            .StartShift:            bit     7,a                 ; if its already 7 bit then shift right one
  15+ 0B51 ~                                    jp      z,.ShiftLoop
  16+ 0B51 ~            .ShiftRight:            srl     h
  17+ 0B51 ~                                    srl     l
  18+ 0B51 ~                                    srl     d
  19+ 0B51 ~                                    jp      .DoneShift
  20+ 0B51 ~            .ShiftLoop:             sla     a
  21+ 0B51 ~                                    jp      m,.DoneShift        ; so if a bit ends up in bit 7 that measn that its negative so we can stop now leavign HLD as 7 bit
  22+ 0B51 ~                                    sla     h
  23+ 0B51 ~                                    sla     l
  24+ 0B51 ~                                    sla     d
  25+ 0B51 ~                                    jp      .ShiftLoop
  26+ 0B51 ~            .DoneShift:
  27+ 0B51                                      ENDM
  28+ 0B51
  29+ 0B51              ScaleY:                 MACRO
  30+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      b,iyl               ; shift de
  31+ 0B51 ~                                    bsrl    de,b
  32+ 0B51                                      ENDM
  33+ 0B51              ScaleX:                 MACRO                       ; as b is already loaded we can just swap over de,hl and do the shift
  34+ 0B51 ~                                    ex      de,hl
  35+ 0B51 ~                                    bsrl    de,b
  36+ 0B51                                      ENDM
  37+ 0B51              ScaleZ:                 MACRO                       ; as b is already loaded we can just swap over de,hl and do the shift
  38+ 0B51 ~                                    push    de                  ; we need DE spare
  39+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      de,bc
  40+ 0B51 ~                                    ld      b,iyh
  41+ 0B51 ~                                    bsrl    de,b

  96+ 0C85              POS_MAT_XLOOFFSET       EQU     00
  97+ 0C85              POS_MAT_XHIOFFSET       EQU     01
  98+ 0C85              POS_MAT_YLOOFFSET       EQU     02
  99+ 0C85              POS_MAT_YHIOFFSET       EQU     03
 100+ 0C85              POS_MAT_ZLOOFFSET       EQU     04
 101+ 0C85              POS_MAT_ZHIOFFSET       EQU     05
 102+ 0C85              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 103+ 0C85              ; Sets IYH to sign bits, bit 7 = x, bit 6 = y bit 5 = z
 104+ 0C85              ; ABS values h = x hi, l = y hi, d = z hi, a to X|Y|Z with sign flags set for 'or
 105+ 0C85              ; z is forced to be 1 if zero
 106+ 0C85              SetIYHToMatSignBits:    MACRO
 107+ 0C85 ~                                    ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_ZHIOFFSET); get Z sign
 108+ 0C85 ~                                    and     $80                     ; and shift it via A into IYH bit 7
 109+ 0C85 ~                                    srl     a                       ;
 110+ 0C85 ~                                    ld      iyh,a                   ;
 111+ 0C85 ~                                    ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_YHIOFFSET); get Y sign
 112+ 0C85 ~                                    and     $80                     ; and shift it via A into IYH bit 7
 113+ 0C85 ~                                    or      iyh                     ; which moves Z into IYH bit 6
 114+ 0C85 ~                                    srl     a                       ;
 115+ 0C85 ~                                    ld      iyh,a                   ;
 116+ 0C85 ~                                    ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_XHIOFFSET); get X sign
 117+ 0C85 ~                                    and     $80                     ; and shift it via A into IYH bit 7
 118+ 0C85 ~                                    or      iyh                     ; which moves Y into IYH bit 6 and Z into IYH bit 5
 119+ 0C85 ~                                    ld      iyh,a                   ;
 120+ 0C85                                      ENDM

 125+ 0C85                                      ENDM

   1+ 0DA7              ; ix = pointer to orientation matrix, each value a 16 bit lead sign word with 1.0 = $6000 (96 in the hi byte)
   2+ 0DA7              ; ix data structure needs to be
   3+ 0DA7              ;       X          y            Z
   4+ 0DA7              ; side +00 , +01   +02 , +03    +04 , +05
   5+ 0DA7              ; roof +06 , +07   +08 , +09    +10 , +11
   6+ 0DA7              ; nose +12 , +13   +14 , +15    +16 , +17
   7+ 0DA7              ;
   8+ 0DA7              ; Re-orthonormalises the matrix against drift (Elite TIDY), working on the hi bytes as Normalise16IX does:
   9+ 0DA7              ;   1. nose = nose / |nose|
  10+ 0DA7              ;   2. make roof perpendicular to nose: pick the nose axis k with the largest |nose_k| (>= 96/sqrt(3) once normalised,
  11+ 0DA7              ;      so the divide is well conditioned and roof moves the least) and set roof_k = -(nose_a * roof_a + nose_b * roof_b) / nose_k
  12+ 0DA7              ;   3. roof = roof / |roof|
  13+ 0DA7              ;   4. side = (nose x roof) / 96, then side = side / |side|
  14+ 0DA7              ; ix is preserved, uses the banked maths routines so MathsBankedFns must be paged in
  15+ 0DA7 DD E5        TidyOrientation:        push    ix
  16+ 0DA9 01 0C 00     .NormaliseNose:         ld      bc,POS_MAT_NOSEVX
  17+ 0DAC DD 09                                add     ix,bc
  18+ 0DAE CD 85 0C                             call    Normalise16IX
  19+ 0DB1 DD E1                                pop     ix
  20+ 0DB3 DD 7E 0D     .PickRoofAxis:          ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_NOSEVXHI) ; correct roof along the largest nose axis
  21+ 0DB6 E6 7F                                and     $7F
  22+ 0DB8 47                                   ld      b,a                     ; b = |nose_x|
  23+ 0DB9 DD 7E 0F                             ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_NOSEVYHI)

  26+ 0DBF DD 7E 11                             ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_NOSEVZHI)

  30+ 0DC7 B9                                   cp      c
  31+ 0DC8 38 22                                jr      c,.FixRoofY             ; x <= z < y
  32+ 0DCA 18 06                                jr      .FixRoofZ               ; z is the largest
  33+ 0DCC 78           .XOrY:                  ld      a,b

  38+ 0DD5 DD 5E 07                             ld      e,(ix+POS_MAT_ROOFVXHI)

  46+ 0DEF DD 5E 07                             ld      e,(ix+POS_MAT_ROOFVXHI)
  47+ 0DF2 DD 46 11                             ld      b,(ix+POS_MAT_NOSEVZHI)
  48+ 0DF5 DD 4E 0B                             ld      c,(ix+POS_MAT_ROOFVZHI)
  49+ 0DF8 DD 7E 0F                             ld      a,(ix+POS_MAT_NOSEVYHI)
  50+ 0DFB CD 71 0E                             call    TidyRoofComponent
  51+ 0DFE DD 73 08 DD                          ld      (ix+POS_MAT_ROOFVY),de

  54+ 0E09 DD 5E 09                             ld      e,(ix+POS_MAT_ROOFVYHI)

   1+ 0EBD              ; fast 16-bit isqrt by Zeda Thomas
   2+ 0EBD              ;Feel free to use for whatever :)
   3+ 0EBD
   4+ 0EBD              sqrtHL:
   5+ 0EBD              ;Input: HL
   6+ 0EBD              ;Output: A is the integer square root of HL
   7+ 0EBD              ;Destroys: HL,DE (D is actually 0)
   8+ 0EBD              ;min: 343cc
   9+ 0EBD              ;max: 380cc
  10+ 0EBD              ;avg: 361.5cc
  11+ 0EBD              ;88 bytes
  12+ 0EBD 11 40 50                             ld de,05040h                ; 10
  13+ 0EC0 7C                                   ld a,h                      ; 4
  14+ 0EC1 93                                   sub e                       ; 4

  16+ 0EC4 83                                   add a,e                     ; | branch 1: 12cc

  20+ 0ECA 92                                   sub d                       ; | branch 1: 12cc

  22+ 0ECD CB A2        sq6:                    res 4,d                     ; 8
  23+ 0ECF CB 3A                                srl d                       ; 8

  26+ 0ED4 38 03                                jr c,sq5                    ;\
  27+ 0ED6 92                                   sub d                       ; | branch 1: 12cc
  28+ 0ED7 CB DA                                set 3,d                     ; | branch 2: 19cc
  29+ 0ED9 CB 3A        sq5:                    srl d                       ; 8
  30+ 0EDB 3C                                   inc a                       ; 4

  32+ 0EDD 30 03                                jr nc,sq4                   ;\
  33+ 0EDF 15                                   dec d                       ; | branch 1: 12cc
  34+ 0EE0 82                                   add a,d                     ; | branch 2: 19cc
  35+ 0EE1 15                                   dec d                       ; | <-- this resets the low bit of D, so `srl d` resets carry.
  36+ 0EE2 CB 3A        sq4:                     srl d                      ; 8
  37+ 0EE4 67                                   ld h,a                      ; 4
  38+ 0EE5 7B                                   ld a,e                      ; 4
  39+ 0EE6 ED 52                                sbc hl,de                   ; 15
  40+ 0EE8 30 01                                jr nc,sq3                   ;\
  41+ 0EEA 19                                   add hl,de                   ; | 12cc or 18cc
  42+ 0EEB 3F           sq3:                    ccf                         ; 4

  44+ 0EED CB 3A                                srl d                       ; 8
  45+ 0EEF 1F                                   rra                         ; 4
  46+ 0EF0 5F                                   ld e,a                      ; 4

  51+ 0EF8 19           sq2:                    add hl,de                   ;/
